data.one_liner: A Flutter bottom navigation bar with frosted glass background and animated active pill.
data.what_it_does: Provides a bottom navigation bar that uses a blur effect to create a glass‑like background. The active tab is highlighted with a translucent, animated pill and optional badge counters.
use_when: You want a glass‑morphism style bottom navigation bar
You need a simple drop‑in widget with customizable colors, blur intensity, and badges
avoid_when: You require built‑in routing or deep‑link handling
Performance is critical on low‑end devices due to blur rendering
strengths: Eye‑catching glass effect with real blur
Highly customizable (colors, height, blur, labels, badges)
Simple API, works as a drop‑in Scaffold.bottomNavigationBar
weaknesses: Blur can be GPU‑intensive on older devices
Only visual navigation; no routing logic included
Requires Scaffold(extendBody:true) and background content for effect
data.setup_notes: Add the package, run flutter pub get, and use Scaffold(extendBody:true) so the frosted effect can sample content behind the bar.
